name: Thaikadar AI SEO Agent
author: Thaikadar.com (ٹھیکیدار)

sections.description:
Optimize hundreds of WordPress posts with AI, without editing every article manually.

Thaikadar AI SEO Agent helps publishers, agencies, and businesses improve their existing WordPress content using AI-powered SEO optimization.

Generate better SEO titles, meta descriptions, FAQs, internal links, and content improvements while preserving your Gutenberg layouts and existing design.

Built for websites with large content libraries, the plugin helps you optimize old posts at scale instead of updating articles one by one.

External Services

This plugin connects securely via server-side API to the OpenAI ChatGPT API (provided by OpenAI, L.L.C.) to execute semantic layout analysis, construct structured tables, answer customer FAQs, and generate high-conversion blog posts.

  • What data is sent and when:
    Data is only transmitted when you trigger actions inside the console (e.g. manually clicking “Bulk Optimize Selected”, “Write Blog Draft”, “Inject Related Links”, or “Generate Campaign Plan”), or when a scheduled cron job runs. The plugin sends your post titles, existing body content, custom anchors, sitemap links, target ICP definitions, and SERP spreadsheet guidelines to OpenAI’s secure completion endpoints (https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions). No data is collected, shared, or sent without your explicit input and active credentials.
  • OpenAI Terms of Service: https://openai.com
  • OpenAI Privacy Policy: https://openai.com

Key Dynamic Features

  • Bulk AI Content Optimization: Analyze and improve multiple WordPress posts using AI-powered suggestions.
  • AI SEO Titles & Meta Descriptions: Generate optimized metadata compatible with Yoast SEO and Rank Math.
  • Smart Internal Linking: Automatically discover relevant internal linking opportunities using contextual analysis.
  • AI FAQ Generator: Create structured FAQ sections designed for better search visibility.
  • Gutenberg Safe Optimization: Preserve blocks, shortcodes, media, and existing layouts during optimization.
  • Content Campaign Planner: Plan and organize future content strategies directly inside WordPress.
  • Backup & Restore: Create recovery points before applying automated changes.
  • Sandbox Mode: Test optimization workflows without consuming API credits.

Support Our Vision

We are fully committed to creating a completely open, high-integrity, and Secure Marketplace together at Thaikadar.com (ٹھیکیدار). Your support on Patreon enables the continuous release of audited, self-hosted WordPress tools for our global community of creators.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the entire thaikadar-ai-bulk-seo-content-optimizer folder to your WordPress plugins directory /wp-content/plugins/, or upload the zip archive via Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin inside your admin panel.
  2. Activate the plugin in WordPress.
  3. Access the newly created workspace ⚡ AI SEO Shield in your lefthand admin sidebar.
  4. Input your ChatGPT API key inside the Settings tab (or leave Sandbox Mode checked to safely test features offline).
  5. Open the Bulk Console, select your articles, and tap into the next era of organic search.
sections.faq:
How does the Smart Internal Link Injector select keywords?

Instead of matching simple keywords which search engines flag as spam, our engine parses target URLs from your sitemap and breaks titles/slugs/anchors into multi-word N-Grams (combinations of 2, 3, and 4 words). It filters out generic stopwords and bigrams (like “real estate”), and prioritizes the longest, most specific long-tail variants to maximize high-value organic search impressions.

What does the Campaign Planner do?

It automates your content lifecycle. You tell the planner your target audience profile (ICP) and plug in raw SERP analysis queries. The planner designs a continuous publishing queue scheduling drafts for hours, days, or custom weekly slots. If you change your marketing focus, a simple “Wipe & Reset” button clears the blueprint database instantly so you can start fresh.

Are custom shortcodes and layout wrappers safe during bulk rewrites?

Yes. We have developed a high-fidelity pre-processing system that acts as a secure container for special HTML markup and custom shortcode sequences. They are parsed and shielded from rewrites, then successfully restored.

Can I reverse an automated change?

Yes. A full-post database snapshot is captured right before any optimization is written. You can rollback any individual article with a single click from the console database table.

  • Released: June 2026
  • Standards Compliance: Completely updated script enqueuing mechanism to use wp_register_script and wp_enqueue_script.
  • Compliance: Removed all raw inline script declarations and transitioned to native wp_add_inline_script bindings.
  • Refactoring: Renamed all generic function, option, define, and localized variable prefixes to use a unique ‘thaiaiseo_’ namespace.
  • Feature Enhancement: Updated smart, high-impression search-friendly long-tail internal linking candidate heuristics.
  • Documentation Update: Revised technical manuals to include detailed walk-throughs for FAQ accordion generators, multi-tier link injected long-tails, and Content Campaign Planners.
  • Routing Standard: Updated primary dashboard hook/slug pathing to ‘thaikadar-ai-seo-agent’ for cleaner administration.

5.1

  • Released: May 2026
  • New Feature: Intelligent “AI Billing / Credit Unreachable” auto-detection with custom diagnostics and action guides.
  • New Feature: Added “Local Sandbox / Demo Mode” to run instantaneous structural optimizations completely offline.
  • Optimization: Fully compatible with WordPress 6.8 & Gutenberg block standards.
  • Bugfix: Standardized parsing for multi-level H3 and H4 elements.
